name: final-repository
description: Final repository with Jules automation for CI/CD and auto-fixing

scripts.jules:full: npm run jules:analyze && npm run jules:fix && npm run jules:optimize && npm run jules:validate
scripts.ci: npm run jules:full && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:cloudflare && npm run deploy:railway && npm run deploy:vercel
scripts.deploy:status: echo "Checking deployment status..." && npx wrangler deployments list && railway status && vercel ls
scripts.domain:setup:
echo "📋 Domain Setup Guide:

1. Get Cloudflare Zone ID from dashboard
2. Update wrangler.toml with zone_id
3. Run: npm run deploy:cloudflare
4. Configure DNS records (see DEPLOYMENT.md)
5. Deploy to Railway and Vercel

See DEPLOYMENT.md for detailed instructions."
scripts.agent:ollama-autonomous: echo "Starting Ollama autonomous agent..." && node scripts/ollama-agent.js || echo "Ollama agent script not found, running in echo mode"
scripts.agent:cloud: echo "Starting cloud agent..." && node scripts/cloud-agent.js || echo "Cloud agent script not found, running in echo mode"

author: Scarmonit
